mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Mystic Forge: the compiler reads the look and the permission (templates_b19); the activated
# ability "{T}, Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library." is the corpus form of "exile the
# top card of your library" (ZNR Valakut Exploration, M21 Furious Rise).
exile_top = A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
    "destination": Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
    "target": Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAnd(children=()),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU, position=ZonePosition.TOP),),
    ),
})
exile_row = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostTap(), CostLife(amount=QConst(value=1)))),
    effect=exile_top,
)
look, permit, carrier = compiled
abilities = [look, permit, exile_row, carrier]

clauses.clause: You may look at the top card of your library any time.
You may cast artifact spells and colorless spells from the top of your library.
{T}, Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library.
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
clauses.evidence: Information only: no event, lane or state change in the trace. The tree is the static LOOK_AT {controller YOU, count 1} (the compiler's B19-look-any-time form; the executor is omniscient). Judged from the tree.

clauses.clause: You may cast artifact spells and colorless spells from the top of your library.
clauses.evidence: Not in the trace (no cast from a library). Packs: A07_1 (a colorless artifact on top is cast from the library paying its {2}: pool empty, a cast from 'library'), A07_2 (a WHITE artifact is cast: an artifact spell), A07_3 (a red instant on top is not offered), A07_4 (a land on top is neither cast nor played), A07_5 (the second card is not offered), A07_6 (the opponent's library top is not offered), A07_7 (with the Forge in the hand nothing is offered), A07_8 (nothing is free: without mana no cast). Not reachable in M20's pool: a colorless NONartifact spell on top (the colorless branch of the filter is the compiler's FNot(at_least(1, COLOR))).

clauses.clause: {T}, Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library.
clauses.evidence: Trace [activate [2] from battlefield]: 'card becomes tapped', 'you loses 1 life' (20 -> 19), one 'you:Library 5#1 moves library -> exile (by card/MOVE_ZONE)', 'you: library 6 -> 5' (the controller's top card, one card). Pack A07_9: exactly the top card (Shock) is exiled, the opponent's library is untouched, the next card (Vial) is then castable from the top, and a second activation the same turn is refused (cost:tap).
